title: Preserve production policy-control continuity in LocomotionActiveShell
hypothesis: LocomotionActiveShell can continue the E58 production policy-control path without changing its calibrated action scales or gains: policy inference remains active, all-joint conditioning uses the E58 scales and component-axis adapter, Physics Control retains the published 1.5 strength multiplier, and target dispatch remains live until the scripted stop transition.
single_behavior_change: Introduce one shared causal-policy-control runtime-state predicate covering standing activation states plus LocomotionActiveShell, and use it only for policy inference/action conditioning, target dispatch, production control publication, zero-actions behavior, and bridge-physics ownership.
explicit_exclusions: Do not apply StandingActivation.ObserveStanding while moving.
Do not alter E58 joint scales or strength values.
Do not relax instability thresholds or fail-stop behavior.
Do not change the E60 script, speed, yaw, shell transform, CMC, capsule, or root authority.
Do not include LocomotionActiveShellDenied or any terminal state.
tdd_contract: LocomotionActiveShell is a causal policy-control runtime state; LocomotionActiveShellDenied is not.
Component-axis action interpretation remains active in LocomotionActiveShell.
Delayed all-joint regions retain their E58 production scales in LocomotionActiveShell after the first active policy snapshot.
Production policy strength remains 1.5 in LocomotionActiveShell after the first active policy snapshot.
ZeroActions still forces all actions to zero in LocomotionActiveShell.
ApplyControlTargets treats LocomotionActiveShell as policy-influence active.
TickRuntimeStateMachine republishes E58 Physics Control topology/gains in LocomotionActiveShell without calling standing observation/failure evaluation.
Policy liveness continues to refresh from successful locomotion target writes.
next_if_supported: Rerun E60 Normal-1 from a clean candidate and require sustained policy samples, nonzero control strength, full scripted path, turn, stop, and settle.
